describesHead.landingTitle: fix(ci): retry marketplace extension installs in the VS Code E2E (#798)

rules.oneOwnerPerRoute: Every row names exactly one production-capable deletion owner (ENCL0 or ENCF0), or names no deletion owner because it is an accepted Rev11 surface that ENCT0 verifies, or a recorded retained/unused item.
rules.inheritedRoutes: parentRoute names the UAK0 route a row splits (D16 for non-editor public positions, D17 for editor contracts). The parent keeps its owner; the row only narrows it. parentRoute null marks a route UAK0 did not list.
rules.productionCapable: ENCT0, ENC1 and UAI0 delete nothing and are never deletion owners here.
rules.identifiable: identifiable=false marks a wire whose unit a consumer cannot determine today from the wire, its type or its fixed contract. It is an observed migration input, not a prerequisite of this contract: the row's intendedContract fixes the encoding, base, domain and refusal rule, and the row's deletion owner delivers it. Production repair is acceptance of that owner.
rules.excluded: Test-only conversions, tooling crates outside the production closure (verter_bench examples, verter_dx_baseline, lsp-test-client) and JS-internal string indices that never cross a Rust boundary (unplugin ssr-transforms) are outside the population.
rules.emission: emission distinguishes positions the head actually produces or reads (produced) from schema fields with no producer (schemaWithoutProducer), ingress fields accepted but never read as a position (acceptedUnread), retained values never interpreted as a position (retainedUninterpreted), dormant internal routes (dormant) and types with no production consumer (noProductionConsumer). A row whose symbols differ is mixed and splits them in emissionBySymbol.
rules.intendedContract: intendedContract is the target each migrated row converges on: domain (CD1-CD6), encoding, base, terminators where a line/column form exists, and refusal. Refusal uses the case-table vocabulary (InvalidBoundary, Overflow, NotCharBoundary) or a named typed failure; nothing clamps, defaults or passes a unit through.

routes.unit: Negotiated LSP Position passed untranslated into the UTF-16 source-map mapper
routes.encodingAtHead: negotiated (UTF-8 preferred, then UTF-32, then UTF-16) on the carrier side; UTF-16 source-map columns inside PositionMapper/ProviderPositionMapper
symbols: LspPosition (doc says negotiated, mapper assumes UTF-16)
routes.defect: A UTF-8 or UTF-32 session maps any position after a non-ASCII character on the same line to the wrong generated column. VS Code offers only UTF-16, so it does not observe it.
routes.successor: the carrier position converts once to a CD1 byte offset at the LSP boundary; the mapper is addressed in bytes or in its own UTF-16 unit through an explicit conversion

intendedContract.domain: CD5 (negotiated LSP) at ingress, CD1 inside the server
intendedContract.encoding: the session's negotiated positionEncoding, converted once through LI1 to a CD1 byte offset; the source-map mapper is addressed in CD1 bytes or in its own UTF-16 column through one explicit conversion
intendedContract.refusal: NotCharBoundary inside a sequence or surrogate pair; InvalidBoundary past the document end; a character past the line length uses the LSP 3.17 rule only for read-only queries, edits refuse

routes.unit: Editor encoding enum used to name the provider wire's UTF-16 and hard-coded UTF-16 literals in provider projection preparation
routes.encodingAtHead: UTF-16 (provider), expressed as tower-lsp PositionEncodingKind::UTF16
routes.successor: provider-wire encoding is named by the provider adapter's own type; the editor enum names only the editor wire

intendedContract.encoding: UTF-16, named by the provider adapter's own encoding type, never by the editor enum
intendedContract.refusal: typed provider-boundary failure; no fallback to the editor encoding

routes.unit: Third code-unit counter beside LI1 and LI4
routes.encodingAtHead: per argument (UTF-8/16/32)
routes.successor: widths come from LI1

intendedContract.encoding: widths computed only by LI1
intendedContract.refusal: as LI1

routes.unit: LI1 line starts break only at \n
routes.encodingAtHead: negotiated columns; lines split on \n only
routes.defect: LSP 3.17 also ends a line at a lone \r; a lone-\r file gets wrong line numbers on every LSP surface and on tsgo LSP-wire responses (K15).
routes.successor: LI1 implements the LSP 3.17 terminator set

intendedContract.encoding: negotiated
intendedContract.refusal: a position between \r and \n is InvalidBoundary (K14)

routes.unit: Unknown negotiated encoding kind silently becomes UTF-16
routes.encodingAtHead: UTF-16 fallback
routes.successor: a closed encoding type; an unknown kind is unrepresentable after negotiation

intendedContract.encoding: closed set UTF-8/UTF-16/UTF-32; negotiation selects only a kind the server implements
intendedContract.refusal: an unrecognised advertised kind is skipped at negotiation and is unrepresentable afterwards; never mapped to UTF-16

routes.unit: Encoding before initialize and when the client advertises none
routes.encodingAtHead: UTF-16 (the LSP 3.17 default when no positionEncodings are advertised)
routes.successor: the default is the wire's rule, applied once at negotiation; no document is converted before negotiation

intendedContract.encoding: UTF-16 only when the client advertises no positionEncodings (the LSP 3.17 wire rule), applied once at initialize
intendedContract.refusal: no document position is converted before initialize; a request before negotiation is refused

routes.unit: Custom-protocol analysis spans converted through the non-editor FFI index
routes.encodingAtHead: negotiated, converted with verter_ffi::convert::OffsetIndex/OffsetEncoding
routes.successor: editor conversions go through LI1 only

intendedContract.encoding: negotiated, through LI1 only
intendedContract.refusal: NotCharBoundary/InvalidBoundary; the span is dropped with a typed reason, never clamped

routes.unit: Audit LSP position records
routes.encodingAtHead: raw negotiated LSP character; the session's encoding is not recorded
routes.note: The value is identifiable inside the session but the record does not carry the encoding, so a reader of the audit record cannot identify it.
routes.successor: the record carries the session's negotiated encoding beside line/character

intendedContract.domain: CD5 of the LSP request being audited
intendedContract.encoding: the session's negotiated positionEncoding, recorded on the PositionInfo record as a closed encoding field beside line/character
intendedContract.refusal: a record whose session encoding is not yet negotiated carries no position (typed absence); it never defaults to UTF-16

routes.unit: VS Code client conversions of server-converted spans
routes.encodingAtHead: UTF-16 assumed (the client advertises only utf-16); styleStructure converts UTF-8 bytes itself
routes.successor: the client consumes server ranges already in the negotiated encoding

intendedContract.encoding: the negotiated encoding the server already converted to (UTF-16 for VS Code); the client does no byte or UTF-8 conversion
intendedContract.refusal: a range the client cannot place is not rendered

routes.unit: Code-action cursor offset
routes.encodingAtHead: UTF-16 code units
routes.successor: versioned encoding-tagged offset converted once at the adapter

intendedContract.encoding: UTF-16 code units from file start, declared by a versioned encoding tag on the request, converted once through LI4
intendedContract.refusal: NotCharBoundary inside a surrogate pair; InvalidBoundary past the end

routes.unit: Host diagnostic spans
routes.encodingAtHead: UTF-16 when the adapter can fetch the source, otherwise raw UTF-8 bytes; compileMany entries are always bytes
routes.defect: The same field and TS type carry UTF-16 or UTF-8 bytes depending on runtime source availability and on which API produced them; nothing on the wire says which.
routes.successor: versioned encoding-tagged spans; a span that cannot be converted is a typed failure, never a silent byte pass-through

intendedContract.domain: CD1 (half-open range in the authored file the diagnostic names)
intendedContract.encoding: UTF-16 code units from file start on NAPI/WASM, declared by a versioned encoding tag on the response; converted once through LI4 against the exact source the compile read (compileMany supplies its own input)
intendedContract.refusal: no source snapshot for the span is a typed SourceUnavailable failure on that diagnostic, never a byte pass-through; NotCharBoundary/InvalidBoundary for an off-boundary or past-end endpoint

routes.unit: Lint diagnostic spans
routes.encodingAtHead: NAPI/WASM: UTF-16 when a source exists, else bytes; MCP: bytes. The Rust Span documented as bytes is rewritten in place with UTF-16 values
routes.defect: Same JSON shape, different units per surface and per runtime source availability; a CD1 Span holds UTF-16 values.
routes.successor: the CD1 span stays bytes; the adapter emits a tagged wire span

intendedContract.encoding: LintDiagnostic.span stays UTF-8 bytes in Rust and is never rewritten in place; the NAPI/WASM adapter emits a separate wire span in UTF-16 code units with a versioned tag; MCP emits UTF-8 bytes with the same tag field (P21)
intendedContract.refusal: missing source is a typed SourceUnavailable on NAPI/WASM, never a byte pass-through; NotCharBoundary/InvalidBoundary per endpoint

routes.unit: Module reference spans
routes.encodingAtHead: UTF-8 bytes, in the same response as UTF-16 diagnostics; WASM reads them back as bytes
routes.successor: tagged spans; one response, one declared encoding per field

intendedContract.encoding: one declared encoding per field, the same as the diagnostics in the same response (UTF-16 on NAPI/WASM), versioned tag; WASM read-back converts through the tag
intendedContract.refusal: NotCharBoundary/InvalidBoundary

routes.unit: Destructured binding and block metadata
routes.encodingAtHead: UTF-16; block bounds index the generated TSX (CD3), bindings the SFC (CD1). WASM converts against "" when the source is missing, which yields 0 for every offset
routes.defect: Missing source silently produces zero offsets.
routes.successor: tagged spans naming their domain (source or generated); missing source is a typed failure

intendedContract.domain: bindings CD1, block bounds CD3; each field names its domain
intendedContract.encoding: UTF-16 code units with a versioned tag
intendedContract.refusal: missing source is a typed SourceUnavailable, never zero offsets; NotCharBoundary/InvalidBoundary

routes.unit: Text edits, document symbols, element and selector matches
routes.encodingAtHead: UTF-16
routes.successor: versioned encoding-tagged ranges

intendedContract.encoding: UTF-16 code units with a versioned tag
intendedContract.refusal: an edit whose range cannot be converted exactly is refused, never clamped

routes.unit: Script-setup attribute source ranges
routes.encodingAtHead: UTF-8 bytes
routes.successor: tagged ranges

intendedContract.encoding: UTF-8 bytes with a versioned tag on the range
intendedContract.refusal: InvalidBoundary for an inverted or past-end range

routes.unit: Analysis, document-structure and symbol-list JSON
routes.encodingAtHead: UTF-8 bytes; unplugin converts structure ranges to UTF-16 itself
routes.tagged: no (FfiStructureRange carries a source-space token, not a unit)
routes.successor: tagged ranges; consumers stop converting locally

intendedContract.encoding: UTF-8 bytes with a versioned tag; consumers convert through the tag, never by local recount
intendedContract.refusal: InvalidBoundary/NotCharBoundary at the converting consumer

routes.unit: Component-meta protobuf spans
routes.encodingAtHead: UTF-8 bytes; CanonicalRange is tagged UTF8_BYTES but no consumer reads the tag; ResolvedTypeDeclaration/ResolvedNativeProp spans are untagged
routes.successor: every span uses the tagged range shape; consumers honour the tag

intendedContract.encoding: UTF-8 bytes in the tagged CanonicalRange shape for every span
intendedContract.refusal: a consumer rejects an unknown encoding tag; InvalidBoundary for inverted ranges

routes.unit: TypeInfo protobuf spans
routes.encodingAtHead: SymbolEntryDto and FrameworkSurfaceMemberDeclaration: UTF-8 bytes; GraphDiagnostic: always zero with has_span=false; GraphSpanRef: no producer and no stated unit
routes.defect: GraphSpanRef is a wire field whose unit is defined nowhere; no producer emits it and no executor reads it on ingress.
routes.successor: tagged spans under the typeinfo wire contract's schema-version rules

intendedContract.domain: CD1 of the file named by canonical_id
intendedContract.encoding: UTF-8 bytes, stated in the typeinfo proto contract under its schema-version rules (GraphSpanRef, GraphDiagnostic, SymbolEntryDto, FrameworkSurfaceMemberDeclaration)
intendedContract.refusal: ingress: an inverted, past-end or off-boundary GraphSpanRef is a typed TypeInfoRequestError before execution; egress: a producer emits a span only when exact, otherwise has_span=false or the field absent

emissionBySymbol.SymbolEntryDto.span_start/end: produced (UTF-8 bytes; the doc comment says SFC-absolute)
emissionBySymbol.GraphDiagnostic.span_start/end: produced as 0 with has_span=false, so no position is emitted (the proto comment says SFC-absolute bytes)
emissionBySymbol.GraphObjectMemberSpans/GraphObjectIndexS: schemaWithoutProducer: every producer emits the field absent
emissionBySymbol.FlowNarrowingRequest.span/ContextualType: acceptedUnread: request validation requires presence; no executor reads the value

routes.unit: Preprocessor diagnostic line/column
routes.encodingAtHead: unknown: neither the line/column base nor the column unit is stated; values are passed through
routes.successor: an ingress contract that fixes base and unit, validated at the adapter

intendedContract.domain: CD5 of the preprocessor's own input text (not the SFC)
intendedContract.encoding: UTF-16 code units, fixed by a versioned NAPI/WASM ingress contract
intendedContract.refusal: the adapter validates line/column against the input it was given; an out-of-range or in-pair position is a typed rejection of the position (the diagnostic keeps its message without a position), never passed through or guessed

routes.note: Accepted from JavaScript and retained on the block-override entry; no Rust consumer maps or re-emits the position: style_diagnostic_of records it absent.

routes.unit: MCP tool positions
routes.encodingAtHead: UTF-8 bytes throughout
routes.successor: versioned encoding-tagged positions; same concept, same unit across MCP and NAPI/WASM

intendedContract.encoding: UTF-8 bytes, stated as a versioned fixed-encoding property of every MCP tool schema
intendedContract.refusal: QuickFixParams.offset inside a UTF-8 sequence is NotCharBoundary; past end is InvalidBoundary

routes.unit: Char-boundary clamping in the FFI converters
routes.encodingAtHead: an offset inside a UTF-8 sequence is clamped down to the previous boundary; an in-pair UTF-16 offset snaps to the pair start
routes.successor: typed NotCharBoundary/InvalidBoundary (K10, K11, K20)

intendedContract.encoding: as the calling row
intendedContract.refusal: NotCharBoundary/InvalidBoundary (K10, K11, K20); no clamp

routes.unit: verter-tsc diagnostic positions
routes.encodingAtHead: 1-based line, 1-based UTF-16 column, rendered as file(line,col)
routes.successor: the CLI locks one-based code-unit coordinates in an explicitly selected encoding (ENCF0 subblock 3)

intendedContract.encoding: an explicitly selected UTF-8/UTF-16/UTF-32 code unit, defaulted by the CLI contract
intendedContract.refusal: an unconvertible position is reported without line/column, never guessed

routes.unit: Audit diagnostic spans in the generated TS bindings
routes.encodingAtHead: UTF-8 bytes (verter_span::Span)
routes.successor: tagged span

intendedContract.encoding: UTF-8 bytes with a versioned tag in the generated binding
intendedContract.refusal: InvalidBoundary for inverted ranges

routes.unit: TCM1 V3 source maps and their extension members
routes.encodingAtHead: 0-based lines, UTF-16 columns; x_verter_helper_preamble_end is UTF-16; x_verter_mapping_product.insertion_anchors are UTF-8 bytes marked only by schema_version
routes.note: Accepted TCM1 surface: not migrated. ENCT0 confirms the byte-valued member is converted exactly once by its consumer.

routes.unit: TCM2 content-mapper projection plane
routes.encodingAtHead: CD1/CD3 bytes (MappingSpan); typed Refusal, no clamping

routes.unit: TCM3 certified engine query offset
routes.encodingAtHead: CD1 byte offset (from LineIndex::position_to_offset), fenced by content_hash, map_hash and required_version; the field's doc comment does not state the unit

routes.unit: H2 core UTF-8 to provider UTF-16 conversion
routes.encodingAtHead: UTF-16 provider wire; tsgo LSP client advertises no positionEncodings; tsserver 1-based UTF-16; Utf16LineIndex retained per diagnostic source in diag_source::SourceFile
routes.note: ENCT0 verifies the K16 terminator behaviour of the tsgo LSP wire against LI1, and the retention scope of LI2 under R05.

routes.unit: TCM4 displaced position routes
routes.encodingAtHead: (line, UTF-16 column) source-map mapping; CarrierMapper in UTF-16 offsets
routes.note: Residual: TCM4's charter names these as displaced and they are still the live position authority. Under ENCT0's charter the residue reopens the Rev11 owner; ENC0 assigns no successor.

routes.unit: Compiler-internal V3 map decoders and UTF-16 column helpers beside LI3
routes.encodingAtHead: UTF-16 columns, \n lines; exact (None inside a pair)
routes.note: Recorded duplicate of LI3. Not a public boundary; ENC1 confirms whether it remains a duplicate conversion owner.

routes.unit: Coordinate types with no production consumer
routes.encodingAtHead: CD3 / CD6
routes.note: Recorded only. GeneratedSpan overloads Span for generated positions. ENC0T decides their fate inside coord/; deleting them is not ENC0T acceptance.

routes.unit: Component and reference schema DTO spans
routes.encodingAtHead: none produced; the fields carry no stated unit
routes.note: No Rust code outside verter_protocol::schema constructs these types; the generated TS mirror is re-exported by @verter/component-meta.

intendedContract.encoding: UTF-8 bytes in the tagged range shape (as P18), or the fields are removed
intendedContract.refusal: InvalidBoundary for inverted or past-end ranges

routes.successor: tagged ranges, or removal of the unproduced fields when generated consumers migrate

alreadyTagged.encodingAtHead: PositionEncoding enum + source_space_token; always UTF8_BYTES offsets
alreadyTagged.note: No migration of the shape; P18 covers the consumers that ignore the tag.

completenessAudit.method: Every public struct or wire message in the production boundary crates (verter_protocol src and proto, verter_ffi, verter_napi, verter_wasm, verter_mcp, verter_tsc, verter_audit payloads, verter_lsp custom protocol) with an integer field named span_start/span_end, start/end, offset, line, column or character, plus their generated TS bindings, was matched to a row. Field-name matches that are counters rather than positions (verter_audit footprint counters) are not positions.
additions: P18 gained FfiResolvedTypeDeclaration and FfiResolvedNativeProp (crates/verter_protocol/src/types.rs), the FFI side of the component-meta spans.
P32 records the verter_protocol::schema DTO spans and their generated TS mirror, which have no Rust producer.
completenessAudit.result: Every matched field maps to exactly one row P01-P32 or to the excluded set in rules.excluded.
